definitions.full: H469. Elitsaphan or Eltsaphan אֱלִיצָפָן proper name, masculine ( God has protected , compare Phoenician צפנבעל ) a. chief of the Kohathites Num 3:30 ; 1Chr 15:8 ; 2Chr 29:13 ; = אֶלְצָפָן Exod 6:22 ; Lev 10:4 . b. chief of Zebulun Num 34:25 .
definitions.rootNote: or (shortened) אֶלְצָפָן ; from 410 and 6845 ; God of treasure;

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Uzziel: Mishael, and Elzaphan, and Sithri.
Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said to them, “Draw near, carry your brothers from before the sanctuary out of the camp.”
The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;
and of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeuel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;
